design_rules: V2 initialization 2026-10-05: this project is a renamed copy of V1, not an implemented V2 converter. All V1-specific rules below describe inherited hardware and its current limitations. Consult electrical/v2/docs/OUTPUT_RECEIVER_STUDY.md and CONTROLLER_V2_INTEGRATED_SPEC.md before redesign. Output 10-60 V / up to 20 A is a provisional study envelope, not implemented or approved; compare with 10-32 V. The 400 W target is input power. AC50S candidate profile is 24 V with <=120 W after qualification. No manufacturing release.

For controller V1, L1 is fixed to Coilcraft MSS1038-473MLC (47 uH, +/-20%) with KiCad footprint Inductor_SMD:L_Coilcraft_MSS1038-XXX. Bourns SRP1038C-470M is only a documented BOM cost-reduction alternative and must not replace L1 without a new lifecycle and availability review.

V1 guarantees a protected-bus ceiling of 70 V maximum continuous, including normal steady-state tolerance. The installed SMCJ70A TVS has 70 V VRWM and does not guarantee that the INA238 stays below its 85 V absolute maximum during a severe surge; 70-80 V operation is out of specification and may damage the measurement or protection chain. LM5164 remains rated to 100 V, but that does not raise the whole-board guaranteed input ceiling. Treat the TVS as short-transient suppression only and validate the actual generator overshoot before operation.

PCB V1 CC/CV control uses U3 = Microchip MCP42100-I/SL, 100 kOhm dual-channel digital potentiometer, with native KiCad symbol Potentiometer_Digital:MCP42100 and native footprint Package_SO:SOIC-14_3.9x8.7mm_P1.27mm. Use write-only SPI nets POT_MOSI/POT_CS/POT_SCK; SO may remain unused when explicitly marked. Use both analog channels CC_A/CC_W/CC_B and CV_A/CV_W/CV_B. Keep the local 100 nF X7R VDD decoupling capacitor. Do not connect either control channel to the external buck until its A/W/B terminals are physically verified within 0-3.3 V and safely below +/-1 mA.

For PCB V1, R1 is fixed to Bourns CSS4J-4026K-2L00F, 2 mOhm, four-terminal shunt. Use native footprint Resistor_SMD:R_Shunt_Isabellenhuette_BVR4026 because its force/sense pad geometry matches the Bourns recommended land pattern. Actual schematic/PCB net mapping is: pad 4 = input after F1 (Net-(D1-K)); pad 3 = SHUNT_HI_K; pad 2 = SHUNT_LO_K; pad 1 = VBUS_SENSE / protected-bus output. Positive current flows from pad 4 toward pad 1. Configure INA238 for the +/-163.84 mV shunt range to retain the 25 A transient envelope. For 25 A full scale, use CURRENT_LSB=762.939 uA and SHUNT_CAL=1250.

For U2 use the validated project footprint BikeGenerator:DFR0868_Beetle_ESP32-C3_V2_Socketed: DFR0868 V2.0 on two 1x8 vertical female sockets, 2.54 mm pitch, 17.78 mm row spacing, USB-C at the footprint top and antenna end at the bottom.
Keep firmware work out of scope until the first physical controller PCB exists; schematic and PCB decisions must not trigger firmware edits.

The controller product envelope is limited by all three independent maxima: protected-bus voltage <= 80 VDC, input current <= 20 A, and input power <= 400 W; these maxima are not simultaneous, so IIN <= min(20 A, 400 W / VBUS). V1 remains guaranteed only to 70 V continuous because the SMCJ70A/INA238 chain does not establish a safe 80 V system limit. V1 must not claim 20 A continuous until F1, D2, copper, shunt, connectors and cooling pass a thermal test; current near 20 A is short-duration prototype operation.

For the first prototypes, populate both J1 direct DC-generator input and J8 plus D2 DBI25-16A 3-phase input to demonstrate both source variants. Never energize or connect sources to J1 and J8 simultaneously. Both paths join at RECTIFIED_RAW before F1. Do not use a solder jumper in the 20 A power path.

F1 is Littelfuse 0456020.ER with project footprint BikeGenerator:Fuse_Littelfuse_456_10.08x3.05mm_P9.35mm. For testing at the 20 A maximum, implement at least 100 um nominal copper and 10 mm-equivalent copper width through the F1 current path, with no narrow necks at the pads. If the fabricated stackup or local copper differs, validate the F1 body temperature and time profile before permitting 20 A operation; V1 does not claim 20 A continuous without this test.

D2 DBI25-16A must not be treated as a 20 A continuous free-standing bridge. For prototype currents above the 4 A free-air rating, bolt its isolated 35 x 25 mm case to a flat aluminum heatsink or chassis with thermal interface material and an M4 fastener tightened to 1 Nm +/-10%, then verify case temperature. Operation near 20 A is restricted to short transients unless a thermal test proves otherwise.

U4 LM5164 RON programming must be wired RON pin -> 41.2 kOhm -> GND. Never connect the RON resistor to VIN; the RON pin absolute maximum is 5.5 V. The 41.2 kOhm value targets approximately 300 kHz at 5 V output.

C5, C7 and C8 use Samsung CL32Y106KCVZ4NE, 10 uF 100 V X7S 1210. Three parts provide approximately 4.18 uF total effective capacitance at 80 V and 25 C from the manufacturer's DC-bias curve, above the LM5164 minimum effective high-frequency input capacitance. This is a deliberate V1 prototype compromise: 100 V rating does not meet TI's conservative recommendation of twice the maximum input voltage, so the protected bus including overshoot must remain at or below 80 V and the capacitors must be thermally and electrically validated.

V2 first schematic increment 2026-10-06 supersedes the inherited U2 Beetle rule: active U2 is official Espressif ESP32-C3-MINI-1-N4X using Espressif:ESP32-C3-MINI-1. Old mcu.kicad_sch is preserved but unreferenced. Bench regulated 3.3 V is mandatory; AUX_5V must never feed U2 directly. Full USB protection, source mux, 1S power path and main converter are NOT implemented. Generic GPIO is signal-only, not field-protected. No internal dump hardware, including DNP. V2 PCB remains the unchanged V1 baseline, intentionally out of sync; no fabrication release. Inherited 70 V and thermal restrictions still apply. Manufacturer pin-map evidence is electrical/components/esp32-c3-mini-1-v2/.

LATEST V2 SCHEMATIC 2026-10-08 supersedes older V2 bench-only/auxiliary/INA rules: USB plus optional protected 1S TP4057/RT9080 logic power; no generator AUX. BQ25756 with MCP4251-503E/SL protected relay manual/app selector; GPIO20 active-low CV_AUTO_N; BQ telemetry only, shared MCU I2C pullups. R1 5 mOhm Kelvin input shunt, R62 1.47k nominal 13.6 A ceiling; 4 input and 6 output TDK bulk caps. Approximately 400 W OUTPUT ambition with high-voltage derating, not an autonomous power cap or validated rating. 55 V ceiling, ACOV begins about 53.4-54.6 V. USB, relay brownout/receiver OV, generator surge, thermal and PCB qualification remain open; JP20/JP30/JP31 open. No internal dump. V1 and copied PCB unchanged, PCB intentionally out of sync. No battery energization/manufacturing approval.

Latest 2026-10-08 voltage70 checkpoint supersedes earlier55V/external-converter rules: integrated BQ25756 only; J2 removed. 70V-class input/output target, ACOV static67.47-69.68V, CV static guard<69.52V;67.2V output requires individual calibration.100V SIR870 FETs and5+7 Panasonic100SXV27M banks do not establish surge or thermal qualification. USB/optional1S Beetle retained, no AUX/no dump, same current ceilings. External source/receiver fuses required and source-dependent; F1 does not cover reversed J1 bridge fault. JP20/30/31 open. No energization, PCB or fabrication approval.
